verification.summary: GradeCalculationHelper tests were date-dependent (hardcoded 2025 vs real Aug-2026 clock) and a theory was tautological; added an optional DateOnly asOf seam mirroring the existing GradeCalculationService pattern, rewrote tests against fixed dates, and added explicit August-boundary coverage. The prior PR CI run passed Backend Build & Test and Windows Canary for this exact two-file change before rebasing onto dev.

reasons.finding: The diagnosis identifies a deterministic wall-clock dependency that makes the suite fail after the August school-year rollover; fixing the test and production time seam conforms to the rule that unreliable red tests must be fixed.

Explicit fixed-date and August-boundary coverage fixes the missing deterministic test coverage in-change and follows the existing GradeCalculationServiceTests pattern rather than introducing a second approach.

reasons.standard: docs/reference/conventions.md § The feature slice (logic flow for a new feature)
reasons.finding: The optional DateOnly parameter is confined to application logic and tests, preserves existing callers through its default, and requires no controller, route, DTO, persistence, entity-mapping, or schema changes.
